topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I walked past the old, ivy-covered cottage at the end of the lane, the one that's always had the tiniest garden and the quietest occupant. Today, the mailman, pausing to wipe his brow, mentioned how the neighbor had been seen driving a sleek, foreign car, one those that whispers as it glides past, not the usual rattle of Mr. Thompson's old truck. It’s curious, isn’t it? The way the quietest streams can run the deepest. I suppose it makes you wonder what else lies hidden behind the walls of that quaint, unassuming home.
